strings.string: Optional name of the person wearing the watch and sending the alert. Every beta notification remains clearly marked TESTNOTRUF and KEIN ECHTER NOTFALL. The name syncs through Garmin services, is stored on the watch, and is visible to configured providers.
Name of person wearing the watch
For example: Alex; the person who will send the alert

Optional details about the person wearing this watch. Grafana shows them in the opened alert; Pushover includes them in its message and may expose them on the lock screen. All entries sync through Garmin services, are stored on the watch, and are sent unencrypted to configured providers.
Address and apartment or access details
Children or dependents connected to the watch wearer: names, ages, pickup or care information
Description of person wearing the watch
Appearance, clothing, and identifying details of the person sending the alert
Relevant personal or threat context responders should know
Who to contact and what to do first
Publicly reachable https:// image URL; Grafana or Pushover links it and the image host can see access

Optional independent TEST route. Emergency profile text and its photo link are visible to Pushover and may appear on the lock screen. After acceptance, real GPS is shared with Pushover and Google Maps for up to one hour.
30 characters from the receiving Pushover account

Formatted-webhook TEST delivery. Receiver setup can add Important Push and in-app acknowledgement. Alert text and GPS links are visible to Grafana. The secret URL syncs through Garmin services and is stored on the watch.
